label: AI assistants
title: AI assistants
intro: Lets Claude and other AI assistants look at your rig and operate it: check the mount, take and review images, focus, guide and run sequences. They act with the access level of the sign-in you give them.
tokenHint: Replace <token> with an access token created on the Security page. A viewer token lets the assistant look but not operate.
skillHint: A short guide for Claude on observing with these tools: the order of a night, units, and when to stop and ask. Save it as SKILL.md in a skills folder, e.g. ~/.claude/skills/astrolol-observing/.

manifest.name: AI assistants
manifest.description: Lets Claude and other AI assistants observe and operate the telescope.
